notes: Read from runs/full/zflx/r2/exec (UI flow CardDemo b0b4438b, map_helper.txt, dispatcher workflow ui_carddemo dc2612f8, systems, data types) and runs/full/zflx/r2/builder (assumptions.md, notes). Transcript: inputs of definition calls only (configure_end_node of ui_carddemo: output ${result}). No run output read, no FlowX call made.

One page, CardDemoPage, one card per legacy screen, shown by ${screen}. Every button starts the same workflow, ui_carddemo, with startParams {screen, action, data: ${<obj>}, session: ${session}} and formsToSubmit []; pageInit starts it with {screen: INIT}. The map's body is that object: screen and action as constants, data.<key> = the card's state object (typed boxes from the form, the card's other state from the adapter session), session.<key> = the signed-on user.

Response paths are top-level: the END node outputs ${result}, the script's UI state patch {screen, msg, msgType, <obj>: {...}, session?, runDate?}. If the run's END output comes back wrapped (result.<...>), every path in this map reads nothing; that is a reading of the END node, not a map choice, and would show at the first step of every case.

State model: a card's typed boxes are form keys <obj>.<field> (refreshed from each same-card response through 'form'); its other UI state (mode, origJson, from, loaded, custId, list rows r<n>, firstKey, lastKey, more, page, expiry, balance, display values) is kept in the adapter session under <obj>.<field>, set from every response that carries the object. A back button that returns show('<list>') (detail opened from a list) carries no object: the list's state stays as the UI keeps it.

Messages: the header has two texts that both read ${msg} (HdrMsgError when msgType == error, HdrMsgInfo otherwise); the map cannot test msgType, so ERRMSG <- msg on every card and INFOMSG <- msg as well on the five legacy maps that have INFOMSG (CACTVWA, CACTUPA, CCRDLIA, CCRDSLA, CCRDUPA). On those maps at most one of the two units can match at a step. TEXT (sign-off page) <- msg ('Thank you for using CardDemo application...'); the ByeCard's own text 'You have been signed off. Thank you for using CardDemo.' is a second text on that page.

AIDs: ENTER = the card's enter-type button; PF3 = Back / Exit / Sign Off (the build labels no button F3); PF4, PF5, PF7, PF8, PF12 = buttons whose label names that key (Clear (F4), Save (F5), Copy Last Tran (F5), Delete (F5), Previous Page (F7)/Backward (F7), Next Page (F8)/Forward (F8), Cancel (F12)). An AID with no such button is absent (not reachable); the list is under not_reachable on each screen.

CACTUPA and CCRDUPA ENTER = 'Validate Changes' (action enter). The script runs the fetch for action enter in search mode, so at workflow level ENTER does what legacy ENTER does there; in the browser that button is hidden in search mode.
COUSR2A and COUSR3A ENTER = 'Fetch' (the card has no other enter-type button; the script runs the fetch for any action but save / delete).

Lists (CCRDLIA, COTRN0A, COUSR0A): each row has its own selection box (input), so CRDSEL<n> / SEL<nnnn> are plain inputs (cl.s<n>, tl.s<n>, ul.s<n>) and the row fields are shown from the response (cl.r<n>.*, tl.r<n>.*, ul.r<n>.*); 'rows/select' is not used because the build chooses the action in the script from the typed value, not per value in the UI.

Fix 7 (compose): 8 templates. CACTUPA: Opened, Expiry Date, Reissue Date, Date of Birth boxes (placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DD') <- {YEAR}-{MON}-{DAY} parts; Phone Number 1 / 2 boxes (placeholder '(999)999-9999') <- ({A}){B}-{C}. CORPT0A: Start Date / End Date boxes (placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DD') <- {YYYY}-{MM}-{DD}. No 'split' is used: no shown value of the build joins legacy fields with a separator its label or placeholder states.

Not mapped (no input, not shown): CORPT0A MONTHLY, YEARLY, CUSTOM (one 'Report Type (M/Y/C)' box; legacy marks one of three fields, a value translation the map format cannot express); CCRDSLA EXPMON, EXPYEAR (one text 'Expiry Date: ${cv.expiry}', no label or placeholder gives the separator); COMEN1A OPTN011-012, COADM1A OPTN005-012 (no option text, assumptions.md #10).

Arrival from a list (CCRDLIA -> CCRDSLA / CCRDUPA, COTRN0A -> COTRN1A, COUSR0A -> COUSR2A / COUSR3A): the response carries the target's object and the list's object (withList). The target's prefilled boxes are shown through a|b paths (fix 6), e.g. ACCTSID 'cl.acctFilter|cv.acctId|cu.acctId'. When a filter / start id was typed on the list, both paths hold a value and the field is marked ambiguous (differs from legacy) although only the target card is visible. The adapter clears the form when the screen changes, so a box the response prefilled on arrival is sent empty on the next step unless the step types it; see MAP_NOTES.md (instrument limitation, not a build behaviour).

Stores: the seven NOSQL systems; document field names and types equal CONTRACT-UI-FULL (INTEGER / FLOAT / STRING as the contract), so 'fields' is empty and no 'as_text'. No loader: none is in the build; the operator's loader comes from make-loader.

Browser: detect = a button only that card shows, in this order: unique buttons first, then buttons unique once those cards are excluded, then cards that share all their buttons with another card (the first in the page's own card order is reported for both: an admin menu as COMEN1A, a card update in edit mode as CACTUPA, a user list as COTRN0A). Cards in search mode (Fetch / Back only: CACTUPA, CCRDUPA, COUSR2A, COUSR3A) are not detected. Since r.ok needs the page to equal both the legacy and the workflow-level navigation, a misreported card can only fail, never pass.

Fix 8-10 update (2026-11-03): CACTUPA/CCRDUPA ENTER, PF5, PF12 and COUSR2A/COUSR3A PF5 are conditional on the card's mode (au.mode, cu.mode, uu.loaded, ud.loaded in the adapter session), following the buttons' hide rules: in search mode ENTER = Fetch; Save (F5) only in confirm mode; Cancel (F12) in edit and confirm mode; Save / Delete (F5) only when a user is loaded. A legacy AID whose button is hidden in the current mode is not reachable. List-arrival boxes come from fix 8 carry (the a|b show paths for ACCTSID, CARDSID, EXPMON, EXPYEAR, TRNIDIN, USRIDIN are removed). Browser: every card is detected by its own title.
